title: Shaded Beige Vanity Top Toilet Tissue Holder, 5.5-Inch Solid Brass Countertop Toilet Paper Stand, Contemporary Bath Accessory, Allied Brass
description: Vanity top toilet tissue holder for bathroom countertops and vanities where wall space is limited in Shaded Beige, which offers sophisticated warmth in a soft, neutral tone that complements natural materials and earthy palettes. Dimensions: 5.5 inches L x 6 inches H x 5 inches W (5.5-inch, 6-inch, 5-inch). Solid brass construction with a weighted base to help prevent tipping; felt pad helps prevent scratching on any surface. Use as a toilet paper holder, toilet tissue holder, tissue holder, toilet roll holder, or countertop toilet paper stand. Contemporary style that fits modern bathroom hardware, contemporary bath accessories, and minimalist bathroom fixtures. Includes: vanity top toilet tissue holder; no assembly required. Product weight: 4 lb. Multiple designer finish options available. Limited lifetime warranty. Allied Brass 1066.
